title: hiring.txt Tier 0
description: Machine-readable data model for the cryptography-free core tier of the hiring.txt recruiter-verification convention. A parser of /.well-known/hiring.txt produces an object conforming to this schema. Comments (lines starting with #) and blank lines are part of the wire-format grammar and are stripped during parsing — they do not appear in this data model.

canonicalDomains.description: Domains from which the company's recruiters legitimately send email. Wire format: comma-separated single line OR repeated keys (comma-safe — hostnames cannot contain commas). Parser MUST support both forms and union the results.

recruitingChannels.description: Official channels recruiters use (LinkedIn company page, careers site, etc.). HTTPS only. Wire format: repeated keys only (URLs may contain commas; comma-splitting is forbidden for this field).

applicationUrls.description: The only legitimate locations where candidates may apply. HTTPS only. Wire format: repeated keys only (URLs may contain commas; comma-splitting is forbidden for this field).

never.description: Machine-readable negative assertions. The company commits it will never do these. Open vocabulary with a well-known token registry; custom tokens allowed in kebab-case format. Wire format: comma-separated single line OR repeated keys (comma-safe — tokens cannot contain commas). Parser MUST support both forms.

verifyContact.description: Official endpoint to confirm whether a person is a genuine recruiter. mailto: or https: URI.

reportAbuse.description: Where to report impersonation. mailto: or https: URI.

verifiedRecruiters.description: Optional list of recruiters' public professional profile URLs (low-sensitivity). Wire format: repeated keys only (URLs may contain commas).

expires.description: Freshness deadline. A verifier MUST treat an expired file as 'unverifiable'.

lastUpdated.description: When the file was last revised.

wellKnownNeverTokens.description: Registry of well-known Never tokens with standardized semantics. Verifiers SHOULD recognize these tokens for automated policy-contradiction checks. Custom tokens beyond this set are valid but may not be automatically matched by all verifiers.

$comment: Wire-format grammar: Lines starting with # (after leading whitespace trim) are comments and MUST be silently discarded. Inline # does NOT start a comment (URLs may contain fragments). Blank lines are silently discarded. Data lines follow Key: Value format. See Format Grammar specification for full tokenization rules. --- Tier 1 adds: signature (string, detached-signature URI or inline), and one of key (PGP public-key URI) or did (did:web identifier). Tier 2 adds per-recruiter Verifiable Credentials resolved via did:web. Those tiers extend this schema and are out of scope for Tier 0.
